subject: facet_grid with a single value facetting variable

messages.author: 7e54aa65e5af5819
messages.subject: facet_grid with a single value facetting variable
parts:
Currently facet_grid doesn't plot the facet label when the faceting
variable has only a single value.

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(subset(mtcars, cyl == 4), aes(wt, mpg)) +
geom_point() +
facet_grid(cyl~.)

For example, when using ggplot in a function to perform exploratory
analysis on a dataset and the faceting variable has an unknown number
of values, then this makes it impossible to see the variable value in
cases when it only has a single value.

Is this so by design, or is it a bug?

messages.subject: Re: facet_grid with a single value facetting variable
parts:
This is by (not very good) design. In a future version I hope to make
this a setting with values TRUE to always display, FALSE to never
display and NA to only display when there is more than one level.

Hadley
